chunks: And it was narrated: “Whoever sits while using nūrah, it is feared for him that he may develop a hernia.”
ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about sitting while using nūrah?
ai.summary: This narration reports a caution regarding sitting while using nūrah. It presents this as a harmful practice from which one should be wary in matters of bodily cleanliness and personal care.
